name: single leg thrusts
description: Hip thrusts done on one leg with your upper back on a support. Builds glute strength and hip stability.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.
